z-m-38-03.title: Mumhinduro yaMinjun ye √(x+2)=x, mutsara upi hauna kururama?
z-m-38-03.topic: Mhinduro dze irrational equation ne extraneous solutions (mamiriro e irrational expressions)
z-m-38-03.goal: Mumhinduro inoita square kumativi ose maviri e irrational equation, tsvaga mutsara une kuongorora kunoshaikwa, tsanangura kuti nei imwe mhinduro inosiiwa, uye ugadzire equation umo chinhu chimwechete chinoitika.
z-m-38-03.material: x i real number. Minjun akagadzirisa equation √(x+2) = x (inoverengwa: 'square root ye x kuwedzera 2 yakaenzana ne x') ndokunyora basa riri pazasi. Mudzidzisi akati, “Pangava nemhinduro dzinopfuura imwe, saka tarisa kana pane mutsara wemhinduro usina kuongororwa.”
z-m-38-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako dambudziko idzva rine chimiro chakafanana
z-m-38-03.prereq.1: Irrational expressions (mukati me square root i0 kana kupfuura, uye kukosha kwe square root i0 kana kupfuura)
z-m-38-03.prereq.3: Hukama pakati pe roots ne coefficients (sum ne product ye roots mbiri)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe wemhinduro une chimwe chisina kururama. (Verenga mitsara kubva ku1.)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x = 2 ne x = −1 imwe neimwe mu equation yekutanga √(x+2) = x, uye verenga divi rekuruboshwe nerekurudyi zvakaparadzana.
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.0: Kuita square kumativi ose maviri kunopa x + 2 = x²
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.3: Kana x = −1, mukati meroot ndi −1 + 2 = 1, isiri negative, saka makosha ose maviri mhinduro dze equation iyi
z-m-38-03.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 hauna kururama. Kana ukaisa x = −1 mu equation yekutanga, divi rekuruboshwe ndi √1 = 1 uye rekurudyi ndi −1, saka zvakasiyana. Chinofanira kutariswa hakusi kuti “mukati meroot hamusi negative” asi kuti “equation yekutanga inoshanda.” Kuverenga kwemitsara 1 kusvika ku3 kwakarurama.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza tsananguro dzose dzakarurama dzekuti nei x = −1 yakasiiwa pamhinduro.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora renji yemakosha anogona kutorwa ne √(x+2), uye ufunge kuti izvi zvinopa mamiriro api kuna x iri kurudyi.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa equation inopa x + 2 = x² nenzira imwechete ku √(x+2) = −x.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.a: Kana yaitwa square, √(x+2)=x ne √(x+2)=−x dzose dzinova x+2=x² imwechete, saka hadzigoni kusiyaniswa
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.a: Tsananguro iyi inoziva kuti kuita square kunodzima ruzivo rwechiratidzo.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.b: Mushure mekuita square pane mhinduro imwe yekuwedzera nguva dzose kupfuura mu equation yekutanga, saka imwe yemhinduro dzakawanikwa nekuita square inofanira kusiiwa nguva dzose
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.b: Kuita square hakuwedzeri mhinduro imwe nguva dzose. Izvi zvinoitwa kuti zvigare zvakadaro pasina kuzviedza iwe pachako pa equation senge √x = 2.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.c: Pakanga paine kukanganisa pakuverenga mu factoring (x−2)(x+1)=0 kwakagadzira mhinduro yekuwedzera
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.c: Factoring yakarurama. Izvi zvinotora chokwadi chekuti quadratic equation ine mhinduro mbiri sekukanganisa pakuverenga.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.d: Zvakakwana kuti x+2 mukati meroot isiri negative, saka mhinduro dzose dzine x ≥ −2 dzinofanira kuchengetwa kunyange dzakabva pakuita square
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.d: Mamiriro emukati meroot anodiwa asi haakwani. Unofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana kana equation yekutanga ichishanda.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.e: √(x+2) i0 kana kupfuura, saka x mu equation yekutanga inofanirawo kuva 0 kana kupfuura, asi equation yakaitwa square haina mamiriro aya
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.e: Tsananguro iyi inoziva kuti mamiriro ekuti square root i0 kana kupfuura anogadzirawo mamiriro kudivi rekurudyi.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.explain: a ne e dzinotsanangura chiitiko chimwechete kubva kumativi akasiyana. Kuita square kunodzima ruzivo rwechiratidzo (a), saka mamiriro 'x ≥ 0' aive ne equation yekutanga anoshaika (e). b i generalization isina kururama, c haina kururama nekuti factoring yakarurama, uye d mamiriro anodiwa asi haakuudzi oga kuti kukosha mhinduro here.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.prompt: Kana a iri positive integer, kuita square kumativi ose maviri e equation √(x+a) = x kunopa x² − x − a = 0. Gadzira makosha matatu akasiyana e a apo roots mbiri dze quadratic equation iyi dzose ari integers. (Mune iyoyo nyaya, imwe yemaroots maviri haisi mhinduro ye equation yekutanga.)
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.0: Daidza maroots maviri r ne s, uye nyora kuti sum r + s ne product rs zvine hukama hwakadini ne a.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.1: Edza positive integers diki a imwe imwe, ongorora kana x² − x − a ichibudisa factors, uye utsvage pattern pamakosha e a anoshanda.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva integer iri 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Maroots maviri e x²−x−a=0 ose ari integers (discriminant 1+4a i perfect square).
z-m-38-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Maroots e x²−x−a=0 haasi integers. Tarisa kana discriminant 1+4a iri square yeinteger imwe.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.explain: Daidza maroots maviri r ne s. Ipapo r + s = 1 uye rs = −a < 0, saka imwe root i positive neimwe i negative. Root negative haigoni kuva mhinduro ye equation yekutanga nekuti √(x+a) ≥ 0. Kuti maroots maviri ose ave integers, r(1−r) = −a, saka a = r(r−1), uye a = 2 (maroots 2, −1), 6 (maroots 3, −2), 12 (maroots 4, −3), 20 (maroots 5, −4), ...

z-m-38-02.title: Graph yakagadzikwa nokungoti mapoinzi maviri ane kukwirira kwakafanana here?
z-m-38-02.topic: Kugadzika fomula yefunction yequadratic, uye kana mamiriro akakwana
z-m-38-02.goal: Kunefunction yequadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c ine f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3, rongedza kuti chii chinofanira kuwedzerwa kuti fomula igadzikwe kuva imwe chete, uye kumamiriro asingagadziki, gadzira mafomula akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro ose.
z-m-38-02.material: Kunefunction yequadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c (a ≠ 0; a, b, c zvinhu zvisingachinji; inoverengwa: 'a x squared plus b x plus c'), zvinhu zviviri zvinozikanwa. Graph inopfuura papoinzi (0, 3) napapoinzi (4, 3). Ndiko kuti, f(0) = 3 ne f(4) = 3. Ruzivo urwu oga haruigadzike fomula ye f kuva imwe chete. Tichapa ruzivo rumwe chete rwakawedzerwa.
z-m-38-02.thinking.2: Kugadzira mafomula akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro akafanana
z-m-38-02.prereq.1: Kuisa makoodhineti epoinzi muquadratic y=ax²+bx+c kuti ugadzire hukama pakati pemakoefficient
z-m-38-02.prereq.2: Chokwadi chokuti mapoinzi maviri ane kukwirira kwakafanana akaenzana pamusoro pechiratidzo chokuenzana
z-m-38-02.prereq.3: Chiratidzo che discriminant b²−4ac nehuwandu hwemapoinzi apanosangana graph ne x-axis
z-m-38-02.s.s1.prompt: Kubva paruzivo pazasi, sarudza zvikamu zvose zveruzivo zvakadai kuti “kuwedzera urwu rumwe chete kunoita kuti fomula ye f igadzikwe kuva imwe chete.”
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza chikamu chimwe cheruzivo chinogona kusarudzwa uye ugadzire mafomula maviri anogutsa pamwe chete ne f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3. Kana ukagadzira maviri, ruzivo urwo harukwani.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kuti hukama hupi pakati pemakoefficient b ne a hunobuda kana f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.a: Inokuudza kuti a yakanaka chete, saka pachine kukosha kwakawanda kwa a kunogoneka. Kana ukaedza a = 1 ne a = 2, zvose zvinogoneka.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.b: Sarudzo iyi inoziva kuti chidiki chinovapo uye kuti kushandisa kukosha kwacho pamwe chete kunokubvumira kutsvaga a.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.c: Graph inosangana ne x-axis papoinzi maviri akasiyana
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvinogoneka kwete chete kana a yakanaka asi kana isina kunaka zvakare, uye kunyange kuna a yakanaka, kukosha kwakawanda kunogoneka. Hauna kuedza kana kukosha kwakati wandei kwa a kuchigutsa mamiriro.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.d: Sarudzo iyi inoziva kuti poinzi itsva rinowedzera hukama humwe chete hutsva kufomula, uhwo hunogadzika koefficient.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.e: Izvi zvinongodzokorora ruzivo rwakatopiwa, saka hazvidzi hukama hutsva. Unofanira kusiyanisa ruzivo rutsva neruzivo rwauri kuziva kare.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.explain: Kana f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3, axis of symmetry ndi x = 2 uye fomula ine chimiro f(x)=a(x−2)²+k. Kana minimum iri −1, saka k = −1, a>0, uye kubva ku f(0)=4a−1=3 tinowana a=1. Kana chiratidzo chiri (1, 0), saka a+k=0 ne 4a+k=3, saka a=1 uye k=−1. Kune rimwe divi, ne “inovhura kumusoro” ne “inosangana pamapoinzi maviri,” a inogona kutora kukosha kwakawanda, uye poinzi (4, 3) ruzivo rwatatoziva.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira quadratic functions 3 dzakasiyana f(x) = ax² + bx + c dzine f(0) = 3 ne f(4) = 3 dzine graph dzinosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana. (Isa a, b, c.)
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3 mufomula, uye tanga wanyora hukama pakati pe a ne b.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wasarudza a, b inotarwa pamwe chete naro. Mushure mekusarudza a, tarisa kana kukosha kwe b²−4ac kuri positive.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.2: Edza zvakare makosha negative e a pamwe nepositive.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuisa x=0 kunopa f(0)=c, saka c inofanira kuva 3.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana (discriminant i positive).
z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Discriminant b²−4ac haisi positive, saka haisangani ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.explain: c = 3, uye kubva ku 16a + 4b + 3 = 3 tinowana b = −4a. Ipapo discriminant ndi 16a² − 12a = 4a(4a − 3), iri positive kana a < 0 kana a > 3/4. Saka pane mafomula asingaperi anogutsa mamiriro ose, senge (1, −4, 3), (2, −8, 3), (−1, 4, 3). a = 0.5 haishande nekuti discriminant i negative.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Nemashoko ako, nyora kuti nei fomula ichiri kusatarwa kamwe chete kunyange tichiwedzera ruzivo rwekuti “inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana.”
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Enzanisa zvakasiyana pamafomula matatu awakagadzira pamusoro.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa kuti ndeipi pa b ne c inochinja pamwe chete kana ukachinja a.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza here kuti mafomula awakagadzira akasiyana, uchishandisa makosha chaiwo e a ne b?
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei mamiriro anoramba achigutswa kunyange a ichichinja (b inotarwa ne a)?
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Mamiriro ekusangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri anoramba achigutswa kunyange tikachinja a kuita makosha akawanda senge 1, 2, −1 uye tikaisa b se −4a, saka pane mafomula akawanda anogutsa mamiriro ose. Ndosaka isingatarwi kamwe chete.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Kunyange ne f(0)=3 ne f(4)=3, discriminant i positive kana a=1 uye kana a=2, saka mafomula akasiyana akawanda anobuda. Mamiriro aya haagadziri kukosha kwe a.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Zvingava zvakanyatsonaka kutaurawo nyaya senge a=−1, apo graph inovhura kuzasi.

z-m-38-06.title: Kana domain ne range zvakagadzwa, pane quadratic functions dzakawanda sei dzinogoneka?
z-m-38-06.topic: Kusarudza ma coefficients e quadratic function ine domain ne range zvakagadzwa
z-m-38-06.goal: Tsvaga ma coefficients mazhinji sezvinobvira e f(x)=a(x−1)²+k ine range 1 ≤ y ≤ 5 padomain 0 ≤ x ≤ 3, uye utsanangure kuti nei zviitiko zvichipatsanuka kuita zviviri uye kuti nei pasina zvimwe.
z-m-38-06.material: Quadratic function f(x) = a(x − 1)² + k (a ≠ 0; a ne k i real constants; verenga se: 'a times (x minus 1) squared plus k') ine domain 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 ne range 1 ≤ y ≤ 5. Ndiko kuti, pachikamu ichi minimum i 1 uye maximum i 5. Cherechedza: pa x = 0, x = 1, x = 3 mu domain, mitengo ye function i a + k, k, 4a + k, nenzira yakateedzana. Minjun akati, “Pane minimum, saka inovhurika kumusoro. Saka pane peya imwe chete (a, k) inogoneka.”
z-m-38-06.thinking.1: Kupatsanura kuita zviitiko uye kuzvitarisa usina kusiya
z-m-38-06.thinking.2: Kunyora chikonzero chechirevo chekuti hapana zvimwe
z-m-38-06.prereq.1: Chiratidzo che a nechimiro chegraph ye quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q
z-m-38-06.prereq.2: Pachikamu chakavharwa, maximum ne minimum zvinobva pakati pemitengo pa vertex nemagumo maviri
z-m-38-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru kwechirevo chaMinjun.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti mutengo mukuru zvikuru nemutengo mudiki zvikuru pachikamu 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 zvinoitika kupi kana a i positive uye kana a i negative.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dhonza graph ine a negative, uye utarise kana vertex i poindi yepamusoro kana yepasi zvikuru yechikamu.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.a: Kwete. Kunyangwe ichivhurika kumusoro, minimum 1 inogona kuitika pamuganhu, saka pangave nepeya yakasiyana
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoziva kuti kana chikamu chakavharwa, minimum inogona kuitika pamuganhu kunze kwe vertex.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.b: Chokwadi. Range ine minimum, saka inovhurika kumusoro, uye ipapo pane peya imwe chete (a, k)
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakasiya kuti chikamu chakavharwa chinogara chine minimum. Kuvapo kweminimum hakugadzi chiratidzo che a.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.c: Kwete. Kunyangwe a i positive kana negative, pane mitengo yakawanda inotevedzana, saka pane mapeya akawanda zvisingagumi
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya kuti mamiriro maviri (minimum ne maximum) anosarudza zvisingazivikanwi zviviri. Hauna kugadza ma equations uye kugadzirisa.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.d: Chokwadi. Vertex iri mukati mechikamu, saka k inosarudzwa seminimum 1, uye zvimwe zvinosarudzwawo zvakasiyana, saka ndizvo
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga chiitiko apo a i positive chete. Kana a i negative, mutengo k pa vertex unova maximum.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.explain: Vertex x = 1 iri mukati mechikamu 0 ≤ x ≤ 3. Kana a > 0, minimum i k uye maximum i mutengo 4a + k pamuganhu x = 3. Kana a < 0, maximum i k uye minimum i mutengo 4a + k pamuganhu x = 3. Unofanira kugadzirisa zviitiko zviviri zvakasiyana.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise mapeya mazhinji (a, k) sezvinobvira apo range padomain 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 i 1 ≤ y ≤ 5. Unoda mapeya maviri akasiyana kana kupfuura. (Hatizokuudza nhamba huru yemapeya.)
z-m-38-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tora a se positive, sarudza kuti mutengo upi pa x = 0, 1, 3 i mudiki zvikuru uye upi i mukuru zvikuru, uye ugadze ma equations maviri.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tora a se negative uye uite zvimwechete.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Maximum pachikamu haisi 5. Tarisa chikuru pakati pe a+k, k, 4a+k pa x=0, 1, 3.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Minimum pachikamu haisi 1. Tarisa chidiki zvikuru pakati pe a+k, k, 4a+k.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.explain: Kana a > 0, minimum i k = 1 uye maximum i 4a + 1 = 5, saka a = 1. Kana a < 0, maximum i k = 5 uye minimum i 4a + 5 = 1, saka a = −1. Saka mapeya anogoneka chete i (1, 1) ne (−1, 5).
z-m-38-06.s.s3.prompt: Nemashoko ako pachako, nyora kuti nei une chokwadi kuti hapana mamwe (a, k) anogoneka kunze kwemapeya awakawana pamusoro. Unogona kunyorawo kuti chirevo chaMinjun chakashaya kupi.
z-m-38-06.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga kuti pane zviitiko zvingani pamwe chete kana ukapatsanura nechiratidzo che a, uye unyore kuti minimum ne maximum zvinoitika kupi mune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-38-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti mangani e a kana k anosarudzwa mune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-38-06.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana a i positive, ...; kana i negative, ...

z-m-38-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mune rimwe nerimwe, wakataura kuti minimum ne maximum zvinobva pa vertex kana pamuganhu here?
z-m-38-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora kuti chikonzero che “hapana zvimwe” i kuti mune rimwe nerimwe chete a imwe uye k imwe ndiyo inosarudzwa here?
z-m-38-06.s.s3.model.0: Kana a i positive, inovhurika kumusoro, saka minimum i k=1 pa vertex uye maximum i 4a+1=5 pamuganhu x=3, saka a=1. Kana a i negative, inovhurika kumusoro pasi, saka maximum i k=5 uye minimum i 4a+5=1, saka a=−1. Pane zviratidzo zviviri izvi chete uye peya imwe kune rimwe nerimwe, saka pane mapeya maviri chete.
z-m-38-06.s.s3.model.1: Vertex iri mukati mechikamu, saka minimum kana maximum inofanira kuva k. Kana ichivhurika pasi, k=5; kana ichivhurika kumusoro, k=1. Imwe inosarudzwa nemutengo pamuganhu x=3, saka a imwe chete inobuda mune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-38-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndisina kutanga kupatsanura nechiratidzo, ndakatsanangura nekupatsanura kuita chiitiko apo k i maximum nechiitiko apo k i minimum.

z-m-38-05.title: Kana tikawedzera mafunctions maviri anokwira, product inowedzerawo nguva dzose here?
z-m-38-05.topic: Increasing functions ne products: kugadzira mienzaniso inopikisa kubva pama products e linear functions, nemamiriro apo chirevo chinoshanda
z-m-38-05.goal: Edza chirevo che “product yemafunctions maviri anokwira inokwirawo,” gadzira mienzaniso inopikisa yakasiyana uchishandisa linear functions, uye usarudze mamiriro apo chirevo chinoshanda.
z-m-38-05.material: Pane mafunctions maviri f ne g ane domain real numbers dzose. “Increasing” zvinoreva kuti kana x₁ < x₂, saka f(x₁) < f(x₂). Seoa akati, “Kana f ne g dzose ari increasing functions, saka product h(x) = f(x)·g(x) inogonawo kuva increasing function.” Seoa akatora f(x) = x + 1 ne g(x) = 2x + 1 ndokuverenga h pa x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.
z-m-38-05.thinking.0: Kuedza chirevo (kwete kuzvitaura chechokwadi kubva pamienzaniso mishoma)
z-m-38-05.thinking.2: Kushandisa mienzaniso inopikisa kusefa nekusarudza mamiriro apo chinoshanda
z-m-38-05.prereq.1: Zvinoreva kuti function inokwira (kana x₁<x₂, saka f(x₁)<f(x₂))
z-m-38-05.prereq.2: Kuverenga makosha e linear functions ne product yawo (x+m)(x+n)
z-m-38-05.prereq.3: Chokwadi chekuti muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa wakakwana kuratidza kuti chirevo chinhema
z-m-38-05.s.s1.prompt: Uchitarisa kuverenga kwaSeoa, chii chakakodzera zvikuru kutaura pamusoro pechirevo chaSeoa?
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora renji ra x rakaedzwa naSeoa, uye uriienzanise nedomain yose.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kune f(x) = x + 1 ne g(x) = 2x + 1, tsvagawo makosha e h kana x iri −3, −2, −1, 0.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.a: Makosha e h akakura nenhevedzano pa x = 1, 2, 3, saka tinoona chirevo chiri chechokwadi
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakawedzera chokwadi chekuti mitengo mitatu yakakura kuderedzwa kuenda kudomain yese. Kuti function ive increasing, inofanira kushanda kune x₁<x₂ dzese.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.b: Sezvo f ne g zvose i increasing, zvinotevera pakarepo kuti chigadzirwa i increasing, saka hapana kutarisa kunodiwa
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakagamuchira chirevo panzvimbo pekuchitora sechinofanira kutariswa. Zvakasiyana nepundutso, chigadzirwa chinokanganiswa nezviratidzo.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.c: Ma x akaedzwa i positive chete, saka zvakaoma kutaura kuti i chokwadi tisati taona mitengo yekurutivi rwe negative zvakare
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunopatsanura range yakaedzwa nedomain yese uye kunosarudza kwekuedza zvakare.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.d: Mitengo inokura nekukurumidza, sa h(3)=28, saka tinogona kutora chigadzirwa se increasing
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakacherekedza kuti mitengo inokura zvakadini. Zvinotaurwa nechirevo hazvisi nezvehukuru hwekukura asi nezve kuwedzera pa x yese.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.explain: Pa x = −3, −2, −1, 0, h i 10, 3, 0, 1. Kubva pa x = −3 kuenda ku −2, h inodzikira kubva ku 10 kuenda ku 3. Muenzaniso waSeoa wakaedza rutivi rwe positive chete, saka hatigone kuziva kana chirevo chakanga chiri chokwadi, uye chokwadi chirevo chinoparara kunyangwe mumuenzaniso uyu.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.prompt: f(x) = x + m ne g(x) = x + n (m ≤ n) zvose i increasing functions. Zvino vaka mienzaniso apo chigadzirwa h(x) = f(x)·g(x) chisiri increasing. Ndiko kuti, ita h(p) > h(q) kune nhamba mbiri p < q. Gadzira mienzaniso 3 ine (m, n) dzakasiyana.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.0: Mushure mekusarudza m ne n, gadzira tafura yemitengo ye h(x) pa x = −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 uye utsvage nzvimbo apo mitengo inodzikira.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana nzvimbo apo mitengo inodzikira, nyora mitengo miviri iyi ye x se p ne q. Chinja m ne n uye uedze kana (m, n) dzimwe dzinewo nzvimbo apo mitengo inodzikira.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m haipfuure n (kuti peya imwechete yema functions isaverengwe kaviri nekuchinjanisa mazita chete).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita m ≤ n (kuti muenzaniso mumwechete une f ne g dzakachinjana usaverengwe kaviri).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c3: p < q asi h(p) > h(q). h haisi increasing.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c3: h(p) haipfuure h(q). Verenga iwe pachako kuti mutengo wechigadzirwa unochinja sei.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana f(x) = g(x) = x (m = n = 0), saka h(x) = x² uye h(−2) = 4 > h(−1) = 1. Kana f(x) = x + 1 ne g(x) = x + 3 (m = 1, n = 3), saka h(−3) = (−2)(0) = 0 > h(−2) = (−1)(1) = −1. Counterexample imwe inokwana kuparadza chirevo. Apo mitengo yemitsara miviri ye linear i negative, hukuru hwechigadzirwa hunogona kudzikira sezvo x ichikura.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.prompt: Tinoda kuwedzera mamiriro kuti chirevo chaSeoa chigare chichishanda. Mamiriro api akakodzera?
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kune mamiriro ega ega, edza kana unogona kuvaka peya yema functions inogutsa mamiriro asi chigadzirwa chisiri increasing.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kuenzanisa f(p)g(p) ne f(q)g(q) kana p < q, funga kuti nhamba dzinowanza f(p) < f(q) ne g(p) < g(q) dzinofanira kuva nechiratidzo chipi.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.a: Ma graphs e f ne g zvose anodarika pa origin uye anokwira kuenda kumusoro kurudyi
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.a: f(x) = g(x) = x i increasing function inodarika pa origin, asi h(x) = x² inodzikira kuna x < 0. Hauna kuvaka counterexample kuti uiedze.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.b: Mitengo yema functions f(0) ne g(0) pa x = 0 zvose i positive
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.b: Wakasiya kuti inogona kuva positive pa x = 0 chete uye negative pa mamwe ma x. Edza ne f(x) = g(x) = x + 1 pa x = −3, −2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.c: Funga domain seyakadzikiswa kuita chikamu apo x > 0
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.c: Kunyangwe domain i positive, mitengo ye function inogona kuva negative. Edza ne f(x) = g(x) = x − 5 pa x = 1, 2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.d: Pa x yese mu domain, f(x) ne g(x) zvose i positive
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.d: Chisarudzo ichi chinosiyanisa domain nemitengo ye function uye chinoziva kuti zviratidzo zvenhamba dzinowanzwa zvinokosha pakuenzanisa zvigadzirwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.explain: Kana p < q, saka 0 < f(p) < f(q) ne 0 < g(p) < g(q), saka f(p)g(p) < f(q)g(p) < f(q)g(q). Counterexample ya a i f = g = x (h i 4, 1 pa x = −2, −1), counterexample ya b i f = g = x + 1 (h i 4, 1 pa x = −3, −2), uye counterexample ya c i f = g = x − 5 (h i 16, 9 pa x = 1, 2).

z-m-38-01.title: Sezvatinoparadzanisa domain, chikuru nechidiki zvinofamba sei?
z-m-38-01.topic: Chikuru nechidiki chefunction yequadratic kana domain ichichinja
z-m-38-01.goal: Sezvo magumo k edomain achichinja, tarisa nematafura ekukosha kuti nzvimbo apanoitika chikuru nechidiki (vertex kana magumo) inochinja sei, uye utaure patsva kufungidzira kwako kwokutanga.
z-m-38-01.material: Heino function yequadratic f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (inoverengwa: 'x squared minus 4x plus 3'). Isa domain se 0 ≤ x ≤ k (k inhamba chaiyo yakanaka), chinja k, uye utarise chikuru nechidiki che f padomain iyoyo. Seoyeon akafungidzira: “Kana muganho wakawedzera, chidiki chinodzikira uye chikuru chinokwira.” Matafura ekukosha anoratidzwa chimwe panguva imwe, nhanho nenhanho.
z-m-38-01.thinking.0: Kuedza kufungidzira uchishandisa matafura ekukosha sehumbowo
z-m-38-01.thinking.1: Chengeta kana kururamisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo rutsva ruchiuya
z-m-38-01.thinking.2: Taura, uchishandisa miganho, kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro (domain) achichinja
z-m-38-01.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori mwero wokuoma wakagoverwa mukugadzira; haireve kuti kurikuramu inoisa zvirimo izvi muGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Fungidzira kuti zvinodikanwa pazasi zvatodzidzwa.
z-m-38-01.prereq.1: Kunyora patsva function yequadratic muchimiro y=a(x−p)²+q kuti utsvage vertex (kuzadza sikweya)
z-m-38-01.prereq.2: Chimiro chegraph yefunction yequadratic nechiratidzo chayo chokuenzana
z-m-38-01.prereq.3: Kuverenga iwe pachako kukosha kwefunction kuti ugadzire tafura yekukosha
z-m-38-01.s.s1.prompt: Matafura ekukosha anoratidzwa chimwe panguva imwe. Pachinhanho chega chega, tonga kubva padata rakaitwa kusvika zvino, uye kana data inotevera ichiuya, chengeta kana kururamisa kutonga uko. (Domain inogara iri 0 ≤ x ≤ k.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mapeya e x ne f(x) kubva patafura yakaratidzwa, uye uise mamaki papanoitika kukosha kudiki nekukuru.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora patsva f(x) muchimiro (x−□)²+□, uye utarise kana x umo kukosha kudiki kunoitika muchimiro ichi iri mukati medomain.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Iyi ndiyo tafura yekukosha ye k = 1 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). Kana x = 0, f = 3; kana x = 0.5, f = 1.25; kana x = 1, f = 0. Pamuganho uyu chidiki i 0 uye chikuru i 3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kana tikaramba tichiwedzera k kupfuura 1, unofunga kuti chii chichaitika kuchidiki? (Fungidzira uchishandisa matafura nefomula yakaitwa kusvika zvino chete.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Nematafura matatu chete, zvose a ne b zvinogoneka. Kana wakafunga chimiro chefomula (inovhura kumusoro), b inonzwisisika; kana wakatarisa chete chimiro chokukosha kuchidzikira, unowana a. Ngatiriedze netafura inotevera.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sezvo k ichiwedzera, chidiki chinoramba chichidzikira
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaenderera nechimiro chokukosha kuchidzikira chete. Function yequadratic inochinja nzira pane imwe nzvimbo, saka unofanira kutarisa kana nzvimbo iyoyo iri mukati momuganho.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubva pa k imwe, inogona kuregedza kudzikira
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kufungidzira uku kunobva pakurangarira kuti graph inovhura kumusoro, saka ine poinzi repasi. Kwariri poinzi repasi iri kunoda kutarisirwa netafura.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Chero k iri yupi, chidiki chinoramba chiri 0
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakatarisa kukosha kuri mukati momuganho chete uye hauna kufunga nezvekukosha kuri kunze kwawo. Kana muganho wakafara, kukosha kwe x kutsva kunopinda.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Iyi ndiyo tafura yekukosha ye k = 3 (0 ≤ x ≤ 3). Kana x = 1, f = 0; kana x = 2, f = −1; kana x = 3, f = 0. Zvakare, kana x = 2.5, f = −0.75. Chidiki i −1.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana tikawedzera k zvakare, kusvika pa k = 5 kana k = 10, chii chichaitika kuchidiki?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Sezvo f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, kukosha kuri pasi zvikuru −1 kunoitika pa x = 2, uye kuna x yakakura kupfuura 2 kukosha kunokwirazve. Saka chero k ichiva 2 kana kupfuura, chidiki chakafanana, −1. Kana wakasarudza a pakutanga, taura kuti tafura ipi yakachinja kufungidzira kwako.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hauna kuona kuti kukosha kunokwirazve mushure mokupfuura x = 2. Enzanisa kukosha pamberi napashure pe x = 2 patafura.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoverenga kubva patafura kuti kukosha kuri pasi zvikuru pa x = 2 uye kunokwira shure kweizvozvo.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kubva pa k = 3, chidiki chinokura chaizvo
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kana muganho wakafara, chidiki chinogona kudzikira kana kuramba chakafanana chete; hachigoni kukura. Wakakanganwa kuti kukosha kwose kubva kumuganho wapamberi kunoramba kuchisanganisirwa kana muganho wakafara.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kuna k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): kana x = 0, f = 3, uye kana x = 4, f = 3, saka magumo ose maviri ane kukosha kwakafanana. Chikuru i 3. Kana tikafarira kusvika pa k = 5, f = 8 pa x = 5 inova chikuru chitsva.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kufungidzira kwaSeoyeon “kana muganho wakawedzera, chikuru chinokura” kunofanira kururamiswa sei?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuna 0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, saka chikuru i f(0) = 3, uye kubva pa k > 4, f(k) inova yakakura kupfuura 3. Kufungidzira kwaSeoyeon kwakarurama chete kana k < 2 kuchidiki, uye chete kana k > 4 kuchikuru. Muganho umo kwakarurama unoparadzana zvichienderana nemamiriro (muganho).
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Nguva imwe chete k painowedzera, chikuru chinowedzerawo, saka Seoyeon akarurama sezvaakataura
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hauna kutarisa kuti chikuru chinoramba chiri 3 kana k = 3 ne k = 4. Unofanira kuenzanisa kana kukosha kwe x kwakawedzerwa kwakapa chimwe chakakura kupfuura chikuru chatovapo.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zvisinei nokuti k inowedzera zvakadini, chikuru chinoramba chiri 3
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakakanganwa kuti f(5) = 8 inooneka pa k = 5. Unofanira kutarisa kana kukosha pagumo kuchiramba kuchikura.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kusvikira k yasvika pa 4 chikuru chinoramba chiri 3, uye chinokura chete k yapfuura 4
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoenzanisa kuti magumo maviri, x = 0 ne x = k, ane kukosha kukuru ndiko kupi.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Vamwe vakatanga vafungidzira “chidiki chinoramba chichidzikira” wobva wachinja pfungwa yavo shure kwokuona tafura kupfuura x = 2, uye vamwe vakafungidzira “inogona kuregedza” uye vakachengeta kufungidzira uko. Taura mumutsetse mumwe kuti tafura ipi yakachinja (kana kuchengeta) kutonga kwako.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.prompt: Padomain 0 ≤ x ≤ k, sarudza k umo (chikuru) − (chidiki) = 4. (k inhamba chaiyo yakanaka.)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuna k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, rongedza chikuru nechidiki patafura uye utsvage musiyano.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ratidza kukosha kwa k patafura umo musiyano uri 4, uye uedze kana zvakafanana kuna k iri pakati (semuenzaniso 2.5 ne 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.a: Musiyano i 4 chete kana k = 4, uye kwete kuna k imwe
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakatarisa kuti musiyano i 4 pa k = 4 chete uye hauna kuedza kukosha kwakaswedera (semuenzaniso 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.b: Musiyano i 4 chete kana k = 3, uye kwete kuna k imwe
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakatarisa kuti zvinoshanda pakukosha kumwe chete uye hauna kuedza kukosha kwakatenderedza.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.c: Musiyano i 4 kunhamba chaiyo yose k iri 4 kana kupfuura (kubva pa k = 4 kuenda mberi)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.c: Hauna kutarisa kuti pa k = 5, chikuru i 8 uye chidiki i −1, saka musiyano i 9.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.d: Musiyano i 4 kunhamba chaiyo yose k kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 4
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.d: Kutonga uku kwakawana muganho umo chidiki chinoramba chiri −1 uye chikuru chinoramba chiri 3 pamuganho.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.explain: Kuna 2 ≤ k ≤ 4, chidiki i −1 (pa x = 2) uye chikuru i 3 (pa x = 0), saka musiyano i 4. Kana k < 2, chidiki chakakura kupfuura −1, saka musiyano uri pasi pe 4; kana k > 4, chikuru f(k) chakakura kupfuura 3, saka musiyano uri pamusoro pe 4.

z-m-38-04.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori mwero wokuoma wakagoverwa mukugadzira; haireve kuti kurikuramu inoisa zvirimo izvi muGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Fungidzira kuti zvinodikanwa pazasi zvatodzidzwa.
z-m-38-04.title: Kana mafomula maviri ose akakodzera marekodhi ose matatu, ndeipi yatinofanira kutenda?
z-m-38-04.topic: Kusarudza fomula inokodzera data (kuenzanisa inverse proportion ne quadratic function)
z-m-38-04.goal: Enzanisa marudzi maviri emafomula anopfuura napoinzi dzedata dzimwechete matatu, sarudza fomula yekutenda uye kusvika papi uchishandisa muyero mutsva nechimiro chemamiriro, uye utaure renji raunotenda.
z-m-38-04.material: 12 L yemvura inodururirwa zvakaenzana mumabhotoro akafanana x (x i positive integer), uye huwandu y (L) mubhotoro rimwe huyerwa. Marekodhi: nebhotoro 1, 12 L; nemabhotoro 2, 6 L; nemabhotoro 3, 4 L. Shamwari mbiri dzakaisa mafomula. Jiwon: y = 12/x (inoverengwa: '12 yakakamurwa ne x'). Hyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (inoverengwa: '2 x squared kubvisa 12x kuwedzera 22'). Mvura haidzvi, uye inokamurwa zvakaenzana pakati pemabhotoro.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Kuverenga iwe pachako kuti uone kana data nemodel zvichienderana
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuti unotenda zvakadini sezvo uchapupu hutsva huchiuya
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Kuwana kukosha kwe function (kuisa x mufomula uye kuverenga)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Kuverenga mafomula e quadratic function ne rational function y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Hukama (nhamba yemabhotoro) × (huwandu mubhotoro rimwe) = huwandu hwose
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Kutarisa marekodhi matatu ari pamusoro chete, sarudza chirevo chakakodzera zvakanyanya.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x = 1, 2, 3 mumafomula maviri ose uye wenzanise nemarekodhi mutafura.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana fomula inopfuura napoinzi nhatu iri yega chete, kana kuti dzinogona kuva dzakawanda.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x iri nyore, saka marekodhi aya oga akakwana kupedzisa kuti fomula yaJiwon yakarurama
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandisa “fomula iri nyore” sechapupu. Kuva nyore kunogona kuva chikonzero chekutenda, asi hakutariswi nedata.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 ine coefficients dzose ari integers saka yakanyatsorurama zvakanyanya, saka fomula yaHyunwoo yakarurama
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakatsvaga kururama mukuona kwemacoefficients. Kuti fomula inokodzera data kunozikamwa nekuisa makosha chete.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Mafomula ose maviri anokodzera marekodhi matatu, saka marekodhi aya oga haagoni kutaura kuti ndeipi yakarurama
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoziva kuti kana mafomula maviri akakodzera data imwechete, data oga haigoni kuasiyanisa.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Fomula inopfuura napoinzi nhatu ndeyega, saka imwe yemaviri inofanira kuva nekukanganisa pakuverenga
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakatenda kuti fomula inopfuura napoinzi nhatu ndeyega. Kunyange quadratic function ichipfuura napoinzi nhatu, fomula yerumwe rudzi inogona kupfuura napoinzi dzimwechete.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Kuisa x = 1, 2, 3 kunopa 12, 6, 4 kumafomula ose maviri, zvinoenderana nemarekodhi. Sezvo mafomula maviri akakodzera data imwechete, marekodhi oga haagoni kuasiyanisa. Kuti usarudze fomula yekutenda, unoda zvimwe zvikonzero, senge muyero mutsva kana chimiro chemamiriro.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: Ruzivo rutsva runoratidzwa rumwe rumwe panguva. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti kutenda kwako mumafomula maviri kunochinja sei.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nhamba yemabhotoro x yaratidzwa mumafomula ose maviri kuti uwane makosha anofungidzirwa iwe pachako, uye wenzanise nekukosha kwakayerwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kana kukosha kwakayerwa kwakasiyana nekufungidzira, funga zvose zviviri zvinogoneka: fomula ingava isina kururama, kana kuyera kungava kusina kururama.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Takakamura mvura mumabhotoro 4 ndokuyera huwandu mubhotoro rimwe: yaiva 3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Kana ukaenzanisa kukosha kwakayerwa uku nemafungidziro emafomula maviri, unopedzisa chii pamusoro pemafomula maviri?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Fomula yaJiwon inofungidzira 3 L pa x = 4, uye yaHyunwoo inofungidzira 6 L. 3 L yakayerwa inoenderana nefomula yaJiwon uye inosiyana zvikuru neyaHyunwoo. Zvinonzwisisika kutenda divi raJiwon pakarepo, uye zvinonzwisisikawo kuyera kamwe zvakare nekuti kuyera kungava nekukanganisa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Kuyera kungava kwakashata, saka yera kamwe zvakare ozotonga
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Iyi hunhu hwekungwarira: kusakurumidza kupedzisa nekuyera kumwe chete, asi kuda kuongorora.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotenda zvakanyanya iyo ine fungidziro isina kusiyana zvikuru nekukosha kwakayerwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Kutonga uku hakuna kutarisa kuti fomula yaHyunwoo inopa kukosha kupi pa x = 4.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: Nemabhotoro 6 kwakayerwa 2 L, uye nemabhotoro 12 kwakayerwa 1 L. (Saka kusvika zvino, marekodhi 5.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Nzira ipi yakakodzera yekutaura kutenda kwako mufomula yaJiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Sezvo data ichikura, kutenda kwako mufomula yaJiwon kunokura. Asi marekodhi 5 oga haagoni kuvimbisa x yose. Kana pane chikonzero (chimiro chemamiriro), kutenda kwako kunogona kuitwa kwakasimba zvikuru.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Marekodhi ose 5 aive akarurama, saka tinogona kupedzisa kuti yakarurama kune positive integer x yose
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Wakawedzera “marekodhi akarurama kashanu” kunyaya dzose. Makosha e x asina kuyerwa haasati atarisirwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Kunyange kana huwandu hwemarekodhi anokodzera huchiwedzera, kutenda kwedu hakuchinji zvachose
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Izvi hazvitore muchidimbu kuti muyero mutsva uchapupu hunoenda nenzira imwechete.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Kutenda kwedu kwakura nekuti marekodhi 5 akakodzera, asi chikonzero chakaparadzana chichiri kudiwa kuti chigare pamakosha e x asina kuyerwa
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoti uchapupu hunosimbisa kutenda, asi chikonzero chinodiwa kuti ugeneralize kunyaya dzose.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Kana ukawedzera nhamba yemabhotoro nehuwandu mubhotoro rimwe, unowana huwandu hwose hwe 12 L nguva dzose. Izvi nekuti mvura haidzvi uye inokamurwa zvakaenzana pakati pemabhotoro.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Uchiziva izvi, unganyorei pamusoro pefomula yaJiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Sezvo x·y = 12, y = 12/x inobva zvakananga pamamiriro, kwete pamarekodhi. Saka tinogona kutaura kuti inoshanda kune positive integer x yose pasi pe fungidziro ye“mvura haidzvi uye inokamurwa zvakaenzana.” Kana fungidziro yaputswa (kana mvura ichidzvira), fomula inochinjawo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Kwete nemarekodhi chete asi nechimiro chemamiriro, tinogona kutaura y=12/x kune positive integer x yose chero bedzi mvura isingadzvi uye ichikamurwa zvakaenzana
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoisa renji rekutenda tichishandisa zvikonzero zvose zviviri pamwe chete: uchapupu hwedata nechimiro chemamiriro.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Tichiri kufanira kuvimba nemarekodhi 5 chete, uye chimiro chemamiriro hachisi hwaro
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Wakashaya kuona kuti hukama hunobva pamamiriro (product inogara) hunotara fomula zvakananga.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Fomula yaHyunwoo yakangoerekana yapfuura napoinzi nhatu, saka fomula yaJiwon haina kururama
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Kuti fomula yaHyunwoo inopfuura napoinzi nhatu hazvireve kuti fomula yaJiwon haina kururama. Fomula yake haienderani nechimiro pamakosha mamwe e x.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.reflect: Pa s1 wakatonga kuti “hatigoni kuvasiyanisa,” uye vamwe vakachinja izvi mushure mekuona muyero wemabhotoro 4, vamwe vakazvichengeta ne“yera kamwe zvakare.” Taura kuti chikonzero chekuchinja kana kuramba kwakadaro kwekutonga kwako chaiva kukosha kwakayerwa here kana chimiro chemamiriro.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.prompt: Hyunwoo akati, “Zvakadaro, quadratic yakakodzera marekodhi matatu, saka inogona kuva yakarurama gare gare.” Tsanangura hwaro hwekuti nei fomula yaHyunwoo isingakodzeri mamiriro aya, uchishandisa nhamba imwe kana kupfuura.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa x = 4, 6, 10, nezvimwe mufomula yaHyunwoo kuti uwane makosha anofungidzirwa, uye utarise kana ari makosha anogoneka mumamiriro chaiwo.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti huwandu mubhotoro rimwe hunofanira kuchinja sei kana nhamba yemabhotoro ichikura, uye kukosha kwefomula kunochinja sei.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana x = ..., fomula yaHyunwoo inopa ... L, asi ...
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nhamba yawakapa ndiyo kukosha kwawakaverenga nekuiisa mufomula yaHyunwoo here?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei kukosha uku kusingakodzeri mamiriro (kana mabhotoro ari akawanda huwandu hunofanira kuderera, hahugoni kuva hwakakura kupfuura huwandu hwose, nezvimwe)?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanzwisisa uye wakanyora here kuti nei “yakakodzera poinzi nhatu” isingakwani sehwaro?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.0: Kana x=4, fomula yaHyunwoo inopa 6 L, asi chaizvo takayera 3 L. Uyezve, hazvienderani nemamiriro kuti huwandu mubhotoro rimwe hunokura zvakare mushure mekunge mabhotoro awedzera. Saka kunyange ichikodzera poinzi nhatu, hatifaniri kushandisa fomula iyi.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana x=10, fomula yaHyunwoo inopa 2×100−120+22=102 L, iri yakawanda kupfuura huwandu hwose hwemvura hwe 12 L. Yakakodzera marekodhi matatu asi yakarasika pamakosha mamwe, saka haigoni kutendwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro iyi inoshandisa kukosha kusingagoneki mumamiriro sehwaro, panzvimbo pekukosha kwakayerwa.
